dunmer.label: Dunmer
dunmer.description: Ash-grey and red-eyed. The old blood of Morrowind.

nord.label: Nord
nord.description: Skyrim's own: pale, broad and made for cold.

imperial.label: Imperial
imperial.description: Cyrodiil-born, and it shows in the bearing.

breton.label: Breton
breton.description: High Rock stock, with a little elf far back.

redguard.label: Redguard
redguard.description: Yokudan blood. The finest swords in Tamriel came with it.

altmer.label: Altmer
altmer.description: Tall, golden, and quietly certain of it.

orsimer.label: Orsimer
orsimer.description: Orc, and unbothered by what that has cost.

khajiit.label: Khajiit
khajiit.description: Elsweyr-born. Watches the room before it enters it.

argonian.label: Argonian
argonian.description: Saxhleel. Black Marsh raised it, and Black Marsh is not gentle.
